resolutions.rationale: Moved hung parliament to the particular-Parliament sense and rewrote its example as an election result, eliminating the prior cross-sense placement ambiguity.
Removed the unqualified claim that every parliament consists of representatives and centered the definition on its legislative function.
Removed term of Parliament and replaced it with a sense-specific legislative body relation directly bound to fixed facts F-007/F-016 and the sense contrast in F-013/F-018.
